title: FlexLine Draw Fee: Payment-Record Points
content:
For a back-billed draw fee on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the payment-record points are taken off the tier's draw fee percent by the late-fee entries on the line in the last 12 months: none takes off 0.25 percentage points; exactly one takes off 0.10 percentage points; two or more take off nothing.

The points come off the percent before the fee is figured on the draw. The last 12 months take the late-fee entries dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the booking date.

## Questions answered

**No late-fee entry on the line in the window?** 0.25 points come off.

**One late-fee entry 10 months before the booking date and one 14 months before?** One is in the window: 0.10 points.

**Three late-fee entries in the window?** Nothing comes off.

*Hypothetical figure:* on FlexLine Standard (2.5%), 0.25 points off leaves 2.25%.
